data.body:
EPIC ACCEPTANCE-CRITERIA REVIEW (all three findings recorded on the epic for a human decision; none acted on unilaterally).

AC3 net-negative lines: re-measured at 8 of 13 consolidation children merged. NET = +241 non-test lines (818 add / 577 del). Per child: 6f18 +86, 4329 +75, 4cee +73, 7e0d +22, 25b4 0, 1cf6 -1, 111a -1, 7931 -13. Trending further positive, not converging. For the total to reach negative the remaining five would have to average about -48 each. Extraction relocates a duplicated body into ONE documented owner, and the plan-review and code-review gates both demand that rationale, so the only way to force the number negative is deleting the 'why' docstrings - trading a real quality signal for a proxy one.

AC2 additions-only in tests/: verified across the same eight. INTENT holds everywhere - no PINNED observable behaviour changed. The literal CHECK fails on two, and in both cases the deletions ARE the consolidation. 25b4 removes duplicated subprocess nested-pytest launch blocks from 14 pre-existing test files, replacing them with run_nested_pytest; no assertion touched. 6f18 has one genuine assertion edit (assert os.path.dirname(marker) == D._rebar_dir(tracker) -> == StorePaths(tracker).rebar_dir) which asserts the SAME property and had no choice: that test existed to pin TWO implementations in lockstep and the consolidation deleted one, so it necessarily re-points at the survivor. The child recorded that in the test docstring.

Pattern across all three (AC2, AC3, and 4329's AC2 'every edge for both surfaces' which claim cannot satisfy since it only walks open->in_progress): every one was written before any child had landed, and each measures a PROXY that correct consolidation work legitimately violates. None is evidence the work is wrong. Recommendation in each case is to restate the criterion as the property it means and keep the proxy as a review heuristic.

GUARD AUDIT: 6f18, 1cf6, 7931, 25b4, 7e0d all ship real scanning guards. 4329 and 111a were MISSING theirs and now have them (2083, 2082, both merged). 4cee has none and its own ACs never claimed one, so it closed honestly - the gap is against the EPIC's AC1. Filed as new story a73e-ca14-59d1-4e9b (filterable-unblacked-indianabat), linked discovered_from 4cee. Designed its matcher: a FILE-level conjunction of 'fit_comment(' and 'to_wire(' false-positives on the DC adapter (to_wire on the description field, fit_comment as its port implementation), so the guard must match at AST FUNCTION scope. That yields exactly two hits - the owner fit_for_send, and acli_cli_ops.py:491 add_comment, the Cloud adapter's legitimate defensive fit, which takes the marker.
